dialect.detail: MetaWare Technologies COBOL Translator 0.9.16 (21/10/2016), targeting Micro Focus COBOL on UNIX with EBCDIC collating sequence emulation. Translator comments use *{ *} markers for transformation annotations.

purpose.domain_detail: IBM MQ Series (WebSphere MQ) message queue management utility — batch copy of messages from one queue to another with optional backout count reset
purpose.summary: BMQ034 is a batch COBOL program that copies MQ Series messages from one queue to another. It accepts parameters for queue manager, input queue, output queue, browse/destructive mode, syncpoint control, dead letter queue handling, and optional filtering by message ID, correlation ID, date, time, and function code. It also supports resetting the backout count.

notable_features: EBCDIC collating sequence emulation on UNIX (MW-COLSEQ copybook)
IBM MQ Series integration (queue manager, browse/destructive get, syncpoint, dead letter queue)
14 LINE SEQUENTIAL file selects for parameter passing
No EXEC CICS or EXEC SQL
verdict.notes: Source is truncated to first 16000 chars; full program is 859 lines. The MetaWare translator converts mainframe-style COBOL to run on UNIX under Micro Focus, explaining the *{ *} transformation markers and UNIX-MF object computer. French comments indicate a French enterprise environment. Program name BMQ034 follows a naming convention suggesting it is part of a larger MQ utilities suite.
